name: Smear
summary: Partnership trick-taking auction game of the All Fours family where teams bid for trump and score points for trumps and captured cards.
rules_text: Deal 10 cards each from 54 cards including two jokers and left bower Jick. Players in order bid the points they will win or pass; highest bidder becomes pitcher and declares trump. Pitcher takes 14-card stock and discards to six, others discard to six, keeping trumps if possible. Pitcher leads trump. Must follow suit led if able, but may play trump instead. Highest of led suit wins unless trumped. Play 6 tricks. Score up to 10 points per deal: High trump, Low trump, Jack, Jick, each Joker, Game by most card points with A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1 10=10, and 3 for winning trump Three. Pitcher failing bid goes set back and scores zero. First team to 21 over multiple deals wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking pitch variant, hidden hands, strategic bidding.
